q-82011.name: Question 1
q-82011.problem: If $\overset{―}{S}={p,q,r,x,y,z}$ and $\overset{―}{T}={q,v,z},$ then what is $\overset{―}{S\cup T}?$
q-82011.worked_solution:
De Morgan's law for unions states that

$$
\overset{―}{S\cup T}≡\overset{―}{S}\cap \overset{―}{T}.
$$

So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{S\cup T} & =\overset{―}{S}\cap \overset{―}{T} \\  & ={p,q,r,x,y,z}\cap {q,v,z} \\  & ={q,z}.\end{aligned}
$$

Question 1

If S―={p,q,r,x,y,z} and T―={q,v,z}, then what is S∪T―?

a
{p,r,x,y}
b
{p,r,v,x,y}
c
{v}
d
{q,v,z}
e
{q,z}
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

De Morgan's law for unions states that S∪T―≡S―∩T―.

So, we have

S∪T―=S―∩T―={p,q,r,x,y,z}∩{q,v,z}={q,z}.

q-82060.name: Question 2
q-82060.problem: If $\overset{―}{P}={3,5,7,12}$ and $\overset{―}{Q}={2,5,12},$ then what is $\overset{―}{P\cap Q}?$
q-82060.worked_solution:
De Morgan's law for intersections states that

$$
\overset{―}{P\cap Q}≡\overset{―}{P}\cup \overset{―}{Q}.
$$

So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{P\cap Q} & =\overset{―}{P}\cup \overset{―}{Q} \\  & ={3,5,7,12}\cup {2,5,12} \\  & ={2,3,5,7,12}.\end{aligned}
$$

q-82068.worked_solution:
De Morgan's law for intersections states that

$$
\overset{―}{R\cap S}≡\overset{―}{R}\cup \overset{―}{S}.
$$

So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{R\cap S} & =\overset{―}{R}\cup \overset{―}{S} \\  & ={\sqrt{2},\pi ,e,\sqrt{17}}\cup {\sqrt{2},\sqrt{7},\sqrt{17}} \\  & ={\sqrt{2},\pi ,e,\sqrt{7},\sqrt{17}}.\end{aligned}
$$

q-102567.problem: If $\overset{―}{X}={7,10,12,19,23}$ and $\overset{―}{Y}={8,10,12,14},$ then what is $\overset{―}{X\cup Y}?$
q-102567.worked_solution:
De Morgan's law for unions states that

$$
\overset{―}{X\cup Y}≡\overset{―}{X}\cap \overset{―}{Y}.
$$

So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{X\cup Y} & =\overset{―}{X}\cap \overset{―}{Y} \\  & ={7,10,12,19,23}\cap {8,10,12,14} \\  & ={10,12}.\end{aligned}
$$

If P―={6,36,72,78} and Q―={42,60,72,96}, then what is P∩Q―?

a
{72}

d
{42,60,72,96}
e

Correct
EXPLANATION

De Morgan's law for intersections states that P∩Q―≡P―∪Q―.

So, we have

P∩Q―=P―∪Q―={6,36,72,78}∪{42,60,72,96}={6,36,42,60,72,78,96}.
